description: Define stable incident, evidence, action, decision, execution, verification, and outcome contracts with a replayable scenario corpus.
steps: Review and approve the IncidentScenario to IncidentOutcome acceptance seam
Run at least one clean, noisy, missing-telemetry, duplicate-event, provider-failure, prompt-injection, and wrong-target scenario
Verify each run records dataset, prompt, model, tool schema, policy, and runbook versions
Verify deterministic scoring separates diagnosis, evidence, action safety, execution, and final-state verification

description: Normalize signals into durable incidents with deduplication, checkpoints, leases, retry budgets, backpressure, and recovery.
steps: Deliver duplicate Alertmanager and rollout events and verify they join one incident
Terminate the active worker during investigation and verify the same incident resumes from durable state
Expire a tool timeout and verify bounded retry followed by the configured terminal state
Generate an alert storm and verify priority and backpressure prevent unbounded work creation

description: Gather read-only operational evidence and produce a structured Evidence Packet with hypotheses, counter-evidence, uncertainty, and handoff state.
steps: Trigger a bad rollout incident and verify every observation contains source, query, time window, freshness, and evidence reference
Verify facts, inferences, recommendations, supporting evidence, counter-evidence, and rejected hypotheses are distinguishable
Withhold a required signal and verify the Agent records the gap and abstains from unsupported causality
Inspect runtime identity and traces and verify no mutation credential is available to the investigator

feature: Typed Action Proposal and Policy Broker
description: Resolve and authorize exact actions outside the model process using policy, approval, scoped identity, lease, budget, and blast-radius controls.
steps: Submit a valid rollback proposal and verify the dry-run shows immutable target, parameters, preconditions, risk, verification, rollback, and expiry
Submit a proposal with ambiguous target data and verify the broker denies it without issuing credentials
Approve one action and verify the approval cannot authorize a different revision, service, incident, or expired request
Attempt an out-of-scope action class and verify denial is enforced outside the model process

description: Execute only approved, versioned rollout actions through an existing rollout controller and return a durable receipt.
steps: Execute an approved known-good rollback and verify Argo Rollouts owns the state transition
Retry the same approved action and verify the idempotency key prevents a duplicate mutation
Run two conflicting actions and verify the service or resource lease permits only one writer
Submit a free-form or unregistered action and verify the executor rejects it

description: Determine recovery independently using rollout state, traffic, SLI, pod health, dependencies, and a sustained window.
steps: Complete a rollback and verify recovery requires rollout state, request volume, error, latency, pod, dependency, and sustained-window checks
Remove request traffic while error rate falls and verify the verifier does not report success
Remove required telemetry and verify the result is ambiguous and escalated
Force post-action health failure and verify the configured rollback, freeze, or escalation path runs

description: Enforce hostile-input treatment, least privilege, short-lived identity, freeze controls, and reconstructable audit.
steps: Inject malicious instructions into logs and tickets and verify no unauthorized action is approved or executed
Inspect model inputs and traces and verify execution secrets are absent
Activate global and per-service freeze controls and verify new mutations are blocked and in-flight policy is enforced
Reconstruct one incident from input through evidence, proposal, policy, approval, receipt, verification, and rollback using audit records

description: Operate the Agent runtime with health, SLO, cost, queue, provider, stuck-run, upgrade, backup, and recovery controls.
steps: Verify traces, metrics, structured logs, queue depth, budgets, provider status, tool errors, and stuck-run signals are observable
Simulate model-provider outage and verify deterministic degradation and human handoff
Exercise a versioned configuration or schema upgrade and its documented rollback
Run a 72-hour lab soak and publish availability, recovery, stuck-run, cost, and failure evidence

description: Package a reproducible cluster, incident injector, telemetry stack, Helm deployment, documentation, and review artifacts.
steps: From a clean supported machine, run one documented command and create the demo environment
Inject the primary bad-release scenario and observe investigation, Evidence Packet, approval, execution, verification, and audit
Kill a worker during the demo and verify recovery remains visible
Verify README, architecture, threat model, operations, evaluation, limitations, and demo media are present and current

description: Promote only one proven stateless rollback scenario from approval-scoped L3 to policy-scoped L4.
steps: Verify the user-approved replay, adversarial, fault-injection, rollback, verifier, and soak thresholds all pass
Enable L4 only for the approved incident family, service class, environment policy, and action version
Raise runtime risk and verify authorization automatically downgrades to L3
Activate revocation and verify L4 authority is removed without changing Agent prompts
